| | | | | | Dear Peter,For many voters across CA-32, ballots have already been cast. If you have already voted, thank you.**For those who have not yet voted, tomorrow is your opportunity to make your voice heard!** I ask for your vote to help defeat incumbent Brad Sherman who has been in office for 31 years. He’s taking money from AIPAC, insurance companies denying fire claims, and special interest groups. He also supports Trump’s tariff policy which is wreaking havoc on our economy and driving up costs for working families. I believe government should work for everyday people—not just those with power, wealth, or special access.Throughout this campaign, I’ve heard from working families struggling in every neighborhood. We must address housing affordability, strengthen public education, defend reproductive freedom, tackle climate change, support small businesses, and create an economy that works for everyone.I believe healthcare should be affordable and accessible. And we must protect Social Security and have Medicare for all. We need comprehensive immigration reform that reflects our values and our humanity.That is the kind of leadership I will bring to Congress.If you have already voted, I ask you to encourage your friends, neighbors, family members, or colleagues to do the same.Together, we can build a future that is more affordable, more just, more inclusive, and more responsive to the people of CA-32.**Thank you for believing in this campaign. Thank you for your support, your energy, and your faith that better leadership is possible.** Let’s finish strong.

But dark money groups have poured over **$3.8 MILLION** into MD-05 to boost my opponents, and my primary election is just **22 DAYS** away.
The pressure is real. Our PUBLIC pre-primary fundraising deadline is in 2 days, and every dollar we don't raise is a voter we can't reach, a door we can't knock, and an ad we can't run in the final stretch of this race.

Now more than ever, we need leadership that’s rooted in honor, service, and respect. And that’s exactly why I’m running for Congress in South Carolina’s First District.

Friend,

As we enter the final day before our primary election, I keep coming back to why I’m running for Governor — what’s at stake, and who this campaign is really about.
| | [CHIP IN BEFORE ELECTION DAY TOMORROW](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9521?t=2&akid=9991%2E400544%2EIrpHXz)
---
As a 35th-generation New Mexican and proud member of Laguna Pueblo, I am of and for New Mexico through and through.

I know firsthand the struggles too many families are facing — because I’ve lived them. I was a single mother raising my child on food stamps and WIC, working multiple jobs just to get by. At one point, I even cleaned my child’s preschool to help cover tuition. Like so many New Mexicans, I had to make impossible choices — including between rent and groceries — and I built a small business just to gain a little more stability and flexibility.
**[That experience is why I’m in this race: to make life easier for New Mexican families and build a future where our kids can thrive.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9521?t=3&akid=9991%2E400544%2EIrpHXz)**

My campaign is about lowering costs, making housing more affordable, strengthening our schools, and addressing the root causes of crime so our communities are safer. New Mexico is already leading in so many ways — from universal childcare to clean energy and our deep cultural traditions — and as Governor, I’ll build on that progress and take it further.
But, if we win tomorrow, it's only the beginning of the hard fight ahead.

Fox News called our race a top pick-up opportunity. One of my possible Republican opponents just put $999,999 of his own money into his campaign. The same donors that elected Trump are funding attack ads filled with lies and misinformation against me, and you can bet that national Republicans will be ready to spend whatever it takes to flip this seat red in November.
**Friend, I’m running for Governor for you — powered by grassroots supporters pitching in $3, $5, $20 when they can. And if I’m going to hit the ground running in the general election, defeat the GOP megadonors, and keep New Mexico blue, I need your help right now to reach my $50,000 pre-primary goal by midnight.**
[**_Please, will you chip in $5 or more now to help fuel our grassroots movement into the general election, win in New Mexico, and build a better future for working families?_**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9521?t=4&akid=9991%2E400544%2EIrpHXz)
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/9521?t=5&akid=9991%2E400544%2EIrpHXz)

Be Fierce.
— Deb

body:
This campaign was never about me. It was always about what we could build together. | | |
---
| Hi friend, Tomorrow is Election Day, **[and we need all hands on deck to get out the vote!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMe9suWVqtFb-BWoi2l0CARS3P8Bf2LsscfSsEtqZTAyPRn9ciMnAJfBv-B1MiqDypdfJrApRNACELB3pAZ9CvAWvAhXmDT49wWW4svwW7Nv-I_423qwq9HDnMwfaV-PJOJRlSOfNjnRSEO87GFSAXJoaN-vez65b9WxX7pCPBKM0UdjW44s-51aB0tL4rc1Um5qrIGZi2pv3aGX7q8Ap3_gubW4ndn0EXiZ9G93B6Yeq/4r5/dskLfmqARby3LvCDacIHhQ/h0/h001.3qt0pJkbZukp32FSwM9Wo7H5RuDkZdZYm7XuPtNE9Rg)** I hope you’ll join us on the doors or on the phones, but I also wanted to write you one last note. When I decided to run for Congress, I didn't do it because I thought it would be easy. I did it because I believed San Francisco had a chance to lead again. I believed that in a moment when too many politicians were telling people to lower their expectations, we could offer something different: a vision big enough to meet the challenges we face. A vision where housing is affordable. Healthcare is guaranteed. Democracy belongs to people instead of corporations. Technology serves humanity instead of oligarchs. And where our elected officials have the courage to fight for ordinary people instead of powerful interests. Over the last several months, together, we've built the largest field operation in San Francisco history. We've knocked on nearly half a million doors. We've hosted dozens of town halls and events in every corner of the city. We've talked to voters one conversation at a time, one block at a time, one neighbor at a time. **While corporate PACs and Super PACs like AIPAC spent millions trying to buy this election, we built something stronger: trust.** While others relied on consultants, insiders, and establishment endorsements,**we relied on people.** That's what gives me hope. Because no matter what happens tomorrow, this campaign has already demonstrated that people are hungry for a different kind of politics. I've spent much of my adult life trying to help build movements that expand what's politically possible. From Bernie Sanders' campaign, to helping elect AOC and the Squad, to launching the Green New Deal. Every one of those efforts started with people telling us we were being unrealistic. Every one of them succeeded because ordinary people decided to believe in something bigger. This campaign is no different. clean_body: This campaign was never about me. It was always about what we could build together. | | | | Hi friend, Tomorrow is Election Day, I hope you’ll join us on the doors or on the phones, but I also wanted to write you one last note. When I decided to run for Congress, I didn't do it because I thought it would be easy. I did it because I believed San Francisco had a chance to lead again. I believed that in a moment when too many politicians were telling people to lower their expectations, we could offer something different: a vision big enough to meet the challenges we face. A vision where housing is affordable. Healthcare is guaranteed. Democracy belongs to people instead of corporations. Technology serves humanity instead of oligarchs. And where our elected officials have the courage to fight for ordinary people instead of powerful interests. Over the last several months, together, we've built the largest field operation in San Francisco history. We've knocked on nearly half a million doors. We've hosted dozens of town halls and events in every corner of the city. We've talked to voters one conversation at a time, one block at a time, one neighbor at a time. While corporate PACs and Super PACs like AIPAC spent millions trying to buy this election, we built something stronger: trust. While others relied on consultants, insiders, and establishment endorsements,we relied on people. That's what gives me hope. Because no matter what happens tomorrow, this campaign has already demonstrated that people are hungry for a different kind of politics. I've spent much of my adult life trying to help build movements that expand what's politically possible. From Bernie Sanders' campaign, to helping elect AOC and the Squad, to launching the Green New Deal. Every one of those efforts started with people telling us we were being unrealistic. Every one of them succeeded because ordinary people decided to believe in something bigger. This campaign is no different. body:
Two days. National speakers. Rodeo. Fireworks. Back the Blue Bash. Here's what's coming.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/sek348431b6)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s7m287a6062)**
| | Peter,
**We're officially 25 days away from Freedom Fest 2026.**
What started as a vision to celebrate Faith, Family, Freedom, and America's 250th Birthday has become one of the most ambitious events we've ever undertaken.
On June 26-27, thousands of patriots will gather at the Douglas County Fairgrounds for two unforgettable days featuring:
🇺🇸 Nationally recognized speakers 🚔 The Back the Blue Bash featuring Dog the Bounty Hunter **🌟** Mountain Majesty Gala featuring Nick Shirley 🤠 A professional rodeo 🎤 Live music and entertainment 📚 Workshops and breakout sessions 🎆 A spectacular drone show finale 🏔 A celebration of Colorado's 150th Birthday
Featured speakers include Greg Gutfeld, Nick Shirley, Lara Logan, Kevin Roberts, Mike Davis, Lee Habeeb, Beverly Aikins, Erin Lee, Dog the Bounty Hunter, and many more.
And we're not done announcing speakers yet. We're announcing _**a member of Trump's cabinet**_ on Friday... you won't want to miss it.
Over the next 25 days, we'll be highlighting different aspects of the event so you can see exactly what makes Freedom Fest unlike anything else happening in America this summer.
If you haven't secured your tickets yet, now is the time. 🎟 GET TICKETS: _**[RMVFreedomFest.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s1i9093f3b6)**_
We'll see you in Castle Rock. For Faith. For Family. For Freedom. For the Future.
The RMV Team
---
[FULL WEBSITE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s7k54a84ad6)
|
---
**🎤 FRIDAY MAIN STAGE
**
_****_The opening day of Freedom Festival brings some of the most powerful voices in America to the main stage.
🔹 **Lara Logan** _— Award-winning journalist & former CBS News chief foreign affairs correspondent_
**🔹** **Dr. Kevin Roberts —** _President of the Heritage Foundation_ 🔹 **Beverly Vance Aikin —** _Mother of VP JD Vance, sharing a powerful testimony of faith and redemption_
**🔹** **Mike Davis —** _Conservative lawyer and founder of a project defending constitutionalist judges_
**🔹 Seth Keshel —** _Former Army Intelligence Captain and nationally recognized election analyst_
🔹 **Lee Habeeb —** _Creator and host of Our American Stories_
🔹**Patti Fox** _— Colorado advocate for public safety and victims' rights_
🔹 **Erin Lee —** _Executive Director of Protect Kids Colorado_
🔹 **Pastor Christine Coleman, Heidi Ganahl, Jeff Hunt & more...**
Friday daytime also includes live music, hands-on workshops, and food trucks on-site all day. This is the **Aware · Act · Advocate** experience. You won't just listen — you'll leave with a plan.
[FRIDAY DAY PASS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s2j6316256e)
|
---
**🚔 FRIDAY EVENING — BACK THE BLUE BASH**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/sakdd772c83)
Friday night is a patriotic celebration honoring the men and women who protect our communities.
**Featuring:**
• DOG The Bounty Hunter — Keynote speaker
• Curtis Grimes Band — Breakout Texas country music artist
• District Attorney George Brauchler
• District Attorney Michael Allen
• Pastor Drake Hunter
• Jeff Hunt
• Law enforcement leaders & special guests
**[General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/sar11be3a4c) — $95 | [VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s9h8232e385) — $150**
[BACK THE BLUE BASH](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/scs3abe6b48)
|
---
**🤠 SATURDAY — RODEO & FAMILY FUN FEST**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/sbnc37bf073)
Saturday brings something for the whole family.
The rodeo kicks off with real Western action, followed by a Curtis Grimes concert and the Family Fun Fest — completely free for families.
**Family Fun Fest includes:**
• Bouncy Houses
• Petting Zoo
• Face Painting
• Magicians
• Sports Mascots
• Food Trucks & Live Music
**[Rodeo General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/sbp8b56f8b3) — $45 | [Rodeo VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/seh37c7360b) — $295** Not into the speakers? This is your perfect Saturday.
[RODEO & FAMILY FUN FEST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/san35d008ea)
|
---
**🎙️ SATURDAY MAIN STAGE**
Saturday afternoon is headlined by one of the biggest names in media today.
🔹 **Greg Gutfeld —** _King of Late Night, host of GUTFELD! — the #1 show in late night, Co-Host of The Five & NYT Bestselling Author_
🔹 **Dr. Robert Malone —** _Original inventor of mRNA vaccine technology and vocal critic of COVID mandates_
🔹 **Dr. James Lindsay —** _Author of Cynical Theories and leading voice exposing woke ideology_
🔹 **Pastor Lorenzo Sewell —** _Delivered the benediction at President Trump's 2025 Inauguration_
🔹 **Data Republican (Jennica Pounds) —** _Software engineer who used AI to expose government waste with DOGE_ __🔹**Jacki & Noelle Caskey —** _Jeffco mother-daughter duo who went viral after Noelle’s middle school banned her pro-life SLAM poem for being "too politically charged"_

Gutfeld is Saturday only. If that's the one name you came for, Saturday daytime is your ticket.
[SATURDAY DAY PASS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s8q06adaaa2)
|
---
**🌟 SATURDAY EVENING — MOUNTAIN MAJESTY GALA + DRONE SHOW**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s4u0007ef18)
The weekend ends with a night you won't forget.
The Mountain Majesty Gala is an elegant dinner event featuring some of the most compelling voices of the weekend — capped off with a spectacular drone show finale over Castle Rock.
**Featuring:**
**•** Nick Shirley — Investigative journalist and immigration fraud whistleblower. The journalist they don't want you to watch.
**•** Larry Gatlin — Grammy-winning country and gospel legend
**•** Pastor Lorenzo Sewell
**•** Special guest from Trump's cabinet!
**[General Admission](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/scub7c5969f)** — $195 | **[VIP](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s0udce8b663)** — $995 | **[VIP + Photo Experience](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/seo91f0232b)** — $1,995 (Or included with the [All-Access](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s2m45540b90) & [VIP Weekend Pass](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/scuec28e97e))
[MOUNTAIN MAJESTY GALA](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s5k047e1bf4)
|
---
**Want to do it all?**
_**America only turns 250 once. Colorado only turns 150 once.**_

This is the weekend that marks both.
**[GET YOUR TICKET NOW →](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s8rdd3496a8)**
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s4t3e23a4d6)
[WEEKEND PASSES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._wA/s5m01c7612d)
|

**Interested in Sponsoring?**
This is a unique opportunity for businesses, organizations, and community leaders to align with a major statewide event celebrating freedom, entrepreneurship, and American values.
Sponsors will have the opportunity to: ⭐ Showcase their brand to thousands of attendees ⭐ Connect with Colorado’s most engaged grassroots community ⭐ Be featured across Rocky Mountain Voice’s growing media platform ⭐ Support a historic celebration of our nation and state
Whether you’re a local business, national brand, nonprofit, or community organization, we’d love to explore how you can be part of this historic event.
[SPONSOR FREEDOM FEST](mailto:shanab@madpaxstrategies.com,brielle@goldpeakstrategiesllc.com?subject=Freedom%20Fest%20Sponsorship%20Interest)

We’re a small but mighty team working through an enormous amount of excitement and ticket demand. If you need assistance, please contact us:
**📧[info@rockymountainvoice.com](mailto:info@rockymountainvoice.com)**
Thank you for supporting independent media, freedom, faith, family, and the future of Colorado. We cannot wait to celebrate with you in June.

Douglas County Fairgrounds
Castle Rock, Colorado**

| | | We want to take a moment to offer you our heartfelt gratitude. For all the ways you’ve supported Ericka and her campaign for Congress, thank you! With early voting starting this month, our team will be reaching out this week and next to schedule volunteer shifts for the Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts. Virtual/remote and in-person canvassing will be available. If you’ve signed up as a volunteer via our website, great! If not, click on the button to volunteer with our campaign.

### Kitchen Table Talks

| | June 14, 11 AM - 12 PM

| [Sign up](https://us.list-manage.com/5Q53e93tBQi?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75)

These are opportunities for you to share what you need to see change in DC to create a positive impact in Virginia. Ericka wants to hear what you and your family need right now. Free event; [register](https://us.list-manage.com/16W1phRp26N?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75) for the Zoom link.

Come [any time between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM on Saturday, June 7th, and](https://us.list-manage.com/KoCBcQRRZN9?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75) [bring your favorite dish to share](https://us.list-manage.com/pr0zHWoPziB?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75).

Due to limited space, registration is required for this outdoor event.

|

### Fun in the sun
---
| [Watch the video](https://us.list-manage.com/ut6nNrOHSXR?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75)

| | | After [sharing our excitement](https://us.list-manage.com/LRvz0hBFrdH?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75) about submitting the petitions on social, we’re packing our schedule with in-person and virtual events across the district in the weeks to come. Check out our [campaign events](https://us.list-manage.com/y9wBRSXpJDT?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75) page to see where you can find Ericka. If you know of an event we should attend or get involved in, let us know by emailing [ekforva@gmail.com](mailto:ekforva@gmail.com).
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
### To VA-1, my family
---
| [Meet Ericka](https://us.list-manage.com/HxLDaXkN_Fx?e=1030105c7f&c2id=b6be358f413c60bd96c5b889c6abad75)
---
| | | _I’ve lived in the first district for more than 30 years. It is the only home I’ve known. The people of this district raised me into the person I am today; they’re like family. My husband and I chose to stay here because of this inclusive community._
_For years now, this family—my family—has been represented by someone who doesn’t listen to us. Rob Wittman chooses politics over people, corporate money over community. But loyalty to a party isn’t the same thing as leadership._
_We need a leader who listens more than she speaks. Someone who won’t bend the knee to the whims of a madman and his circus of destruction. Someone who has the courage to stand up for the people of this district. I’m running for Congress because my family needs a fighter in their corner to make their needs known in Washington._
_I’m fighting to fight for you._
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | |
### A people-powered campaign
---

---
| | | Ericka can’t run this campaign without your help. Every dollar you give goes directly to organizing, knocking on doors, and getting her message to voters who are ready for change.
We say NO to:
* Corporate money
* AIPAC money
* Lobbyist money
* Billionaire money
* Predictions markets
* Stocks/trades

We rely on individual donations to meet our campaign needs. No matter the amount you can invest in this campaign, your contribution matters! So if you are tired of being ignored by Washington, chip in now and join the movement to fix it.

# **Indiana has lowest gas prices in the country, governor may extend tax suspension**
[Click Here to Read the Full Story](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auhhhll-hhlljjcji-y/) WTHI-TV 10

[https://www.wthitv.com/news/indiana-has-lowest-gas-prices-in-the-country-governor-may-extend-tax-suspension/article_c5647c49-dfa0-445a-a077-f29cc00c5b2a.html](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-auhhhll-hhlljjcji-t/) Prices at the pump have skyrocketed since the US-Israeli conflict with Iran began.
Brandon Bell/Getty Images via CNN Newsource Indiana pump prices are the lowest in the country according to a report from GasBuddy.This comes after Gov. Mike Braun suspended two major gas taxes, and he says he might extend the suspension again.According to GasBuddy, the national average price for gas sits at around $4.45 per gallon. This price is up about $1.32 from last year.However, the Hoosier State is sitting well below that price, at just $3.90 per gallon -- the cheapest in the country. This comes after Braun suspended the gasoline usage and excise taxes."Many states could not do this because they are not run very well, the economic growth is not there," Braun said. "The good news is we are getting a dividend by running state government more efficiently in the year and a half I have been here, and we have the best economic growth in decades."Braun says that cutting costs and juicing revenue made addressing pump price sticker shock an easy decision."It's been good that legislators have been behind me on that. It was my option to do it," Braun said. "And I feel so good about the state's future, how we are running state government, that it was a simple gesture for Hoosiers."The tax suspensions are set to expire in June."Hoosiers deserve a break, and I will look at it again in early June, because there is nothing more pleasing to me than Indiana having the lowest gas prices in the entire country," Braun said. ## Trump Unfazed as Iran Suspends Talks

## School Leaders to Meet with Lawmakers
Texas school [administrators are heading to Austin](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGSpDAMRU9jMncZmYEmcLAJ2Wy6ISWw3LhGYMoWQ8_tt2CPsImi__Sk_-dz_MTIcXv9xpWcvEMaNzoLkwjlcWfckqS9hJQDrpEjlRLfgUcw0GrTagOjx8g_Y1N5Nxnf1xW5unsa2z_r50e1uMkCTr5DwN7axvQUOjub0KDxT9tBW0V3LTOtgbo21jSP-qMj23jqCaYwWVCNIR8l5YcsJPTGEvgnfVN-zGmt2C0ie1H2l4JBwXCe52PmOH_Bko4iabtSCobrLQXDzSsYLqeCwdyjVjCEnFZd5iUl1jOncmQqWpIugiHo-ZCib1ajX-NW9BmZtSfByHo6_ItEn-kfwniu-EX58lTZ-f3KxtJ2qjGvFSPfh8v_1f3t4G8AAAD__6hNloo) this week to tell lawmakers about the impact of last year's school funding overhaul. The Texas House Committee on Public Education is reviewing [the rollout of House Bill 2](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOqzAQheGnMV2QGRvHFC5uFKEUyS12iy2RgYGMdogt7E3I26-SV9j-0znS_3XpLp6YbvN_v6DL2xS6Gz4SY864dpH9LeQQ0xTWyS_EhCnRNnEHEsxOmp2EbvTEz04Xo-vl2FQFumpvpWpsZevi6lRl6gZNPTTKmtqr3g7GauiVNqBrJQtyrzFpJFSVVFKXVb1HpUdsEPqpVyC0xJFyWMt8xYybTxM_wx3XcghLwe6ac0xC_RPQCmgHHykHLt-wnMNdQHsg5nMI3z9RQHuilMP6LH2Km1DtGedPTEmoo20-BJiXFep4OkCxujE-iJmS2Qst58UTvz_z30rdHfwGAAD__2gmfAc), the $8.5 billion school funding package passed in 2025. Superintendents and principals from across the state are expected to describe school closures, teacher layoffs, and holes in special education services. Districts say the law's complicated funding formulas left many of them worse off, especially [smaller](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAUhJ8GMyxA_AsINjGbTTe0jnJwTg2CBcyMvv2W9xVu3tXd3_fvMT-APIXtL-xoyuniHPCbPZaCaT48hFjikV1MDnbyhDnT6fyshOq46LhQswXy16wraxZhR1mhkf0gmnGQQ1s9jVtQONCddHoYu1aiEv0ytg61kxocVmTuMtEJJaVohK5l22OjLY6oFrc0immBlkpMdXliwROy81f8YKrXuFfePEs5Mmv-MDUxNaE_IMcdboBcx7QxNd0DTE2iZWqS4x06KFu-vO2GhVt0tFLhjgKElcBzPGnDsF58gfBK76OsFy8J1heFjTsg_06YmZqqZOzxJe8pdz3TYtuB_M-r8juXH6P-BwAA__-kRYrX) and [rural schools](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OpjAMxJ8mdP6UhP8FxTV0e-2VKCRmY20gKPYtH29_Yl_hOlsjzcxv_nwsH44SHZ-_3Y6TvLe8HHhxQhEsy5nckSWfvOWyuZ0SITO9t7RYbTvQHWi7BEfpXpoqTKsOo6lwMv2g63EwQ1vFaRzN1g_DGlrdm9A6NGatbde3jXFova9oesx0p60xutbNy7Q91k3AEe26rbVVjcZAkstLIgq-HW_pzt9YXj7vVZqiyMmq_qXsrOx8Xdfri508orLzQ6PsnLJ3Sdn5iVJ21u3Prews0QlDzBesJX8hSERgH3NOEIilkBcgBl9uFpfAk9xAHCA6hoTMINEd0GoNdAgW2oH_nlie5wh4CLC7nwJVmcJ5UUrEXa8a_bk7Sj8A8n-zf0_2XwAAAP__ibWYmQ). Teacher recruitment and retention have reportedly taken a hit as budgets tightened. The hearings are part of a broader end-of-session review as the legislature wraps up its regular 2026 business.
## Preparing for Hurricane Season
The Atlantic hurricane season officially opened yesterday, with the potential to impact 367 miles of Texas Gulf coastline. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) [is forecasting below-normal activity](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAUhJ8Gd0T82YkLim3c3W23tA7mEKNgsOAkTt5-5bzCrUea-eb79zP_QEwx3__ChpbeocwZj5aQCOu8J8iFyt5CqQG2mCK2Ft8hzUqogYuBCzV7iOkzm85bJ_woO7TyehN6vMlb3602BNUP3vVmGHvXA_bayGWRxjgNYXC6i_YsE4NQUgotzEX2V9TG44jKBacVMwJ9pFIvtCLhG1pIn_LCelnK1iW7Eu2N6T9MTUxNj-C3M2BqOp8wNaWyQGJqWp-1xgUy8obQSuYO7zE3TsXDhx8rEG_lSStCI_7d4W0tz-T5I5eDh1L5SdpV6_cjphTbcGVG3DeI6YtCvxP4sup_AAAA__9g4YfL) for the season, with 8 to 14 named storms and 1 to 3 major hurricanes, well below historical averages. The Colorado State University's hurricane group agrees, citing El Niño-driven wind shear that tends to weaken storms before they can intensify over the tropical Atlantic. However, a quiet basin-wide forecast does not project where storms will go. NOAA has been clear that landfall location can't be predicted months out, and one direct hit can make any season catastrophic for the community in its path.
